checked_claims.note: Reconstructed intrinsically: deg W_5 = 4g+12-4f = 36-20 = 16 (SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6), deg omega = 2g-2 = 10, so deg L = 6 and chi(L) = 6-6+1 = 1; Serre duality gives h^1(L) = h^0(omega ⊗ L^{-1}) = h^0(omega^{⊗2} ⊗ W_5^vee) = h^0(M) with deg M = 20-16 = 4; hence h^0(L) = 1 + h^0(M). The derivation uses only Riemann-Roch and Serre duality and never invokes W_5 ≅ omega^{⊗2}(-D). Valid on every geometric fibre.

h^1(M) = h^0(omega ⊗ M^{-1}) = h^0(L) = 1 + h^0(M) ≥ 1, so M is special with 0 < deg M = 4 < 2g-2 = 10; Clifford gives h^0(M) ≤ 3, hence h^0(M) ∈ {0,1,2,3} and h^0(L) ∈ {1,2,3,4}; h^0(L) = 5 is impossible. Clifford equality cases O (deg 0) and omega (deg 10) are excluded by degree, so h^0(M) = 3 forces hyperelliptic fibre with M ≅ (g^1_2)^{⊗2}; the converse holds since h^0(2g^1_2) = 3 on a hyperelliptic curve. The iff is correct.

Under O(1)|_C ≅ omega_{C/P^1} ⊗ gamma^*A: deg omega_{C/P^1} = 2g-2+2·4 = 18 = 2g+6, and SRC-0004 gives deg O(1)|_C = 2g+6, so 4·deg A = 0, hence A ≅ O because Pic^0(P^1) = 0. Then W_5 ≅ (O(1)|_C)^{⊗2} ⊗ gamma^*O(-5) ≅ omega^{⊗2} ⊗ gamma^*O(-1) = omega^{⊗2}(-D), L ≅ omega(-D), M ≅ gamma^*O(1) = O(D); degrees 16/6/4 check. Injectivity of gamma^*: H^0(P^1,O(1)) -> H^0(C,O(D)) follows from the trace splitting gamma_*O_C = O ⊕ E^vee (char 0, degree 4 invertible), so h^0(M) ≥ 2 and h^0(L) ∈ {3,4}. Considered attack: a Pic(P^1_B) base-twist ambiguity would still leave every fibrewise conclusion unchanged and is excluded by the theorem's stated A ∈ Pic(P^1) (Tschirnhausen-normalized reading); relative conclusions are base-twist invariant anyway (see strongest_attack).

L is B-flat (line bundle), pi proper, B locally Noetherian, so upper semicontinuity makes B_4 = {h^0 ≥ 4} closed and B_3 = {h^0 = 3} open; by (H3) these are the only values, giving a locally closed stratification. On B_4: M ≅ (g^1_2)^{⊗2} ≅ gamma^*O(1); via h^*: H^0(P^1,O(2)) ≅ H^0(M) (3-dimensional, injective by trace splitting, hence an isomorphism), the pencil defining gamma corresponds to a 2-dimensional subspace of H^0(O(2)) which must be base-point-free (otherwise gamma's own pencil would have base points), hence defines a degree-2 map q: P^1 -> P^1 with gamma = q ∘ h; degree count 2·2 = 4 checks, so gamma is non-primitive on B_4.

On U_3 the function h^0(L_b) is constantly 3; Grauert's theorem (proper + flat coherent sheaf over locally Noetherian base, constancy of h^0 only) gives pi_*L locally free of rank 3 commuting with arbitrary base change; R^1 pi_*L need not vanish and is irrelevant. With the quotient convention for projective bundles, the fibre of P((pi_*L)^vee) at b is P(H^0(L_b)^vee) = |L_b| ≅ P^2.

Intrinsic part verified directly: on a smooth curve every length-6 subscheme is Cartier, so Hilb^6_{C/B} = Sym^6(C/B); the Abel-Jacobi fibre over the section [L] of Pic^6_{C/B} is closed (relative Picard separated) and represents divisors Gamma with O(Gamma) ≅ L; over U_3 it is P((pi_*L)^vee) because divisors in |L| are sections modulo scaling, so it agrees with the Proj model there; restricting agreement to the reduced-support open only avoids non-reduced scheme-structure questions and is safe. The scheme-theoretic coincidence with Z_ev = a_N^{-1}(e(B)) is inherited from ATT-0048 (CLM-0048-4/5/7), campaign-confirmed by REV-0091/REV-0092, and the theorem scopes that coincidence exactly to bases carrying ATT-0048's ordered/configuration data, so there is no overclaim.

finding_candidates.statement: For a line bundle L of relative degree d on a smooth proper curve family C/B, the functor of relative effective divisors Gamma with O(Gamma) ≅ L is represented by the Abel-Jacobi fibre Sym^d(C/B) ×_{Pic^d_{C/B}} B, which is closed because the relative Picard is separated; on a smooth curve Hilb^d = Sym^d since every length-d subscheme is Cartier. This model is correct over all of B, whereas Proj(pi_*L) has correct fibres only over the open where h^0(L) is constant; over that open the two agree because divisors in |L| are sections modulo scaling.

strongest_attack: Strongest attack (considered, repelled): Pic(B)-ambiguity in the CE normalization. The collapse {1,2,3,4} -> {3,4} and the identifications W_5 ≅ omega^{⊗2}(-D), L ≅ omega(-D), M ≅ O(D) all rest on the single input O_{P(E^vee)}(1)|_C ≅ omega_{C/P^1} ⊗ gamma^*A. Read over the family C -> P^1_B, the ambiguity could a priori be A ∈ Pic(P^1_B) with a nontrivial base part pi^*A_B, which would make the relative isomorphisms of (H3) hold only up to a base twist and could corrupt (H5)/(H6). Outcome: repelled three ways: (i) the theorem states A ∈ Pic(P^1), the Tschirnhausen-normalized reading — in characteristic zero the trace splitting gamma_*O_C = O ⊕ E^vee canonically fixes E, hence P(E^vee) and O(1), killing base twists; (ii) any base twist restricts trivially to geometric fibres, so every fibrewise conclusion (h^0 ∈ {3,4}, hyperelliptic/non-primitive characterization of B_4) is unaffected; (iii) the relative conclusions are invariant under base twists (Grauert local freeness survives tensoring pi_*L by a line bundle from the base, P((pi_*L)^vee) is unchanged, and the Abel-Jacobi incidence is canonically isomorphic after reclassifying L). Runner-up attack: the scheme-theoretic coincidence incidence = Z_ev in H6 is citation-only (ATT-0048 CLM-0048-4/5/7, whose content is not re-verifiable inside this review workspace); repelled because the theorem scopes the coincidence exactly to bases carrying ATT-0048's ordered/configuration data and ATT-0048 is campaign-confirmed (REV-0091/REV-0092), while the intrinsic incidence model (closed Abel-Jacobi fibre; Hilb^6 = Sym^6 on smooth curves) was verified directly. The remaining adversary list (Tate twists, Poincare duality, Borel-Moore versus cohomology degree, Gysin/Kunneth shifts, spectral-sequence differentials, invariants versus coinvariants, semisimplification, predicted motives, stable pairs) has no surface: H7 explicitly excludes all Hodge/Tate conclusions and the proof is entirely sheaf-level. Evidence limitation: ATT-0048, REV-0091/REV-0092, SRC-0004 and the packet body were not directly readable in this workspace; dependency verdicts for them rest on the campaign record cited by the attempt plus intrinsic consistency cross-checks.
theorem_statement: Let B be a locally Noetherian scheme over a field of characteristic zero, pi: C -> B a smooth proper morphism with geometrically connected fibres of genus g=6, and gamma: C -> P^1_B a finite flat morphism of degree 4 whose Casnati-Ekedahl relations bundle F is fibrewise balanced F ≅ O(4) ⊕ O(5). Let 0 -> W_4 -> W -> W_5 -> 0 be the canonical Harder-Narasimhan filtration of W = (O_{P(E^vee)}(2) ⊗ gamma^* F^vee)|_C constructed in ATT-0048 (CLM-0048-6), so that W_5 is the invertible quotient of fibrewise degree 16 under the SRC-0004 convention W_f = (O_{P(E^vee)}(2) ⊗ gamma^* O_{P^1}(-f))|_C. Set L := W_5 ⊗ omega_{C/B}^{-1} (fibrewise degree 6) and M := omega_{C/B}^{⊗2} ⊗ W_5^vee (fibrewise degree 4). Then: (H1) On every geometric fibre, chi(L)=1 and h^0(L)=1+h^0(M) by Riemann-Roch and Serre duality, with no use of W_5 ≅ omega_C^{⊗2}(-D). (H2) On every geometric fibre, M is special (h^1(M)=h^0(L)≥1), and Clifford's theorem yields h^0(M) ∈ {0,1,2,3}, hence h^0(L) ∈ {1,2,3,4}; the value h^0(L)=5 never occurs; equality h^0(M)=3 holds if and only if the fibre is hyperelliptic and M ≅ (g^1_2)^{⊗2}. (H3) Under the standard CE relative-canonical normalization in the weak form O_{P(E^vee)}(1)|_C ≅ omega_{C/P^1} ⊗ gamma^* A for some A ∈ Pic(P^1), the SRC-0004 degree deg(O(1)|_C)=2g+6 forces deg A=0, hence A ≅ O, and therefore W_5 ≅ omega_C^{⊗2}(-D), L ≅ omega_C(-D), and M ≅ O_C(D) where D is any fibre of gamma (i.e. O_C(D) ≅ gamma^* O_{P^1}(1)). Consequently gamma^*: H^0(P^1,O(1)) -> H^0(C,O(D)) is injective, so h^0(M)≥2 and h^0(L) ∈ {3,4} on every balanced geometric fibre. (H4) Semi-continuity stratifies B into locally closed subschemes B_k = {b ∈ B : h^0(L_b)=k} for k ∈ {3,4} (the only values allowed by (H3)), with B_4 contained in the locus of hyperelliptic fibres on which gamma is non-primitive (factors as q ∘ h through the hyperelliptic double cover). (H5) On the open U_3 := B_3 (where h^0(L) is constantly 3), Grauert's theorem supplies that pi_* L is locally free of rank 3 and commutes with arbitrary base change; P((pi_* L)^vee) -> U_3 is a relative P^2-bundle whose geometric fibre over b is |L_b| ≅ P^2. (H6) Over all of B the relative degree-six linear system of L is the closed incidence locus inside the relative effective-divisor space (equivalently the Hilbert scheme Hilb^6_{C/B}, or the Abel-Jacobi fibre of the section classifying L), not Proj(pi_* L); the two models agree over U_3 after restricting to the reduced-support open. By ATT-0048 (CLM-0048-4, CLM-0048-5, CLM-0048-7), this incidence coincides scheme-theoretically with the CE evaluation-failure locus Z_ev = a_N^{-1}(e(B)) on any base carrying the ordered or configuration data of ATT-0048. (H7) Explicitly excluded from this theorem: emptiness of B_4 (constancy h^0(L)≡3 on the whole balanced locus; equivalently, non-existence of balanced non-primitive tetragonal pencils — GAP-H0-1); pure dimension 17 or codimension 4 of any image in M_{6,6}; smoothness of Z_ev or of its ordered reduced open; nonemptiness of the reduced-support open on every fibre; and any Hodge/Tate conclusion.
